seoTitle: Change Background, Homepage, or Header Photos in Squarespace
metaDescription: Replace an image in Squarespace, whether it's a background, homepage, or header photo, using your own upload or free stock images.
intro: Keeping your visuals fresh is one of the easiest ways to make a Squarespace site feel current, and replacing an image takes just a few minutes. This guide covers swapping out a background, homepage, or header photo, including using Squarespace's free stock image library.

steps.heading: Log in and open your site
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, using Continue with Google if linked, then select the site you want to update.

steps.heading: Enter edit mode
steps.body: Navigate to the page containing the image, then click Edit to enter Edit Mode.

steps.heading: Select the image to change
steps.body: Click directly on the image you want to replace — this could be a gallery, banner, or product photo — and an Edit option will appear.

steps.heading: Replace it with a new image
steps.body: Click Replace to upload a new image from your computer, or click Browse Stock Images to search Squarespace's free stock library and select one.

steps.heading: Save your changes
steps.body: Click Add Image to confirm your selection, then hit Save to apply the change to your live site.

faq.question: Can I use free stock photos instead of my own images?
faq.answer: Yes, Squarespace provides a stock image library with high-quality visuals you can search by keyword and use for free.

faq.question: Does replacing a homepage image affect other pages?
faq.answer: No, replacing an image only updates that specific spot — other pages keep their own images unless you change them separately.

faq.question: Can I change a product image the same way?
faq.answer: Yes, the same click-and-replace process works for product photos on eCommerce pages.

faq.question: How often should I update my site's visuals?
faq.answer: There's no fixed rule, but refreshing visuals periodically helps keep a blog, portfolio, or business site feeling current.
